title: FIFA World Cup 2034 venue requirements register
provenance: Transcribed from screenshots of a 52-page requirements register (Venue Compliance Hub — Saudi Arabia 2034) dated 2026-11-20. It is a transcription of that register, not an independently verified statement of FIFA's contractual requirements; most checks are working targets whose 2034 contract clause is still to be confirmed.

status.WT: Working target · threshold to be confirmed (2034 clause)
status.Book: Numerical criterion from the FIFA stadium book or guidance; still subject to the 2034 contract clause

capacityTiers.note: STA-0004: 40,000 seats for group matches to the quarter-final (and the third-place play-off), 60,000 for a semi-final, 80,000 for the opening match and final; each stadium's highest match selects its threshold.
